figurative_meaning_en: Giving away an eight-year-old daughter in marriage
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুরনো দিনে অনেকে গৌরী দান করে থাকতেন, যা আজ অসম্ভব।
তারা মেয়েকে গৌরী দান করে দিল, কিন্তু পরে অনুতাপ হল।
example_sentences_in_english: In old times, many would perform Gauri daan, which is unthinkable today.
They married off their daughter through Gauri daan, but later regretted it.
history: Refers to ancient Hindu practices of kanyadaan (daughter's giving away) ideally before puberty, with 'Gauri' symbolizing an eight-year-old girl akin to Goddess Parvati; rooted in Vedic traditions but now condemned as child marriage.
note: This idiom highlights outdated and harmful cultural norms; modern usage is critical or historical.
